title: Timing barrier test exceeds bounded authenticated-DIO issuance capacity
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py::test_network_clear_and_option_mismatch_advance_replay_barriers authenticates three DIO facades before elevating the first. The bounded LinkLayer authenticated-DIO issuance registry evicts authenticated1, so verifier.verify(authenticated1) deterministically raises 'authenticated DIO is not a live LinkLayer issuance'. Sequence the authenticate/elevate operations or explicitly configure/assert capacity without weakening the production bound.
